topic.title: Local Development Orders / Simplified Planning Zones / Monitoring
topic.source_contract: order boundary, permitted classes, conditions, exclusions, consultation, environmental assessment, adoption, commencement, expiry, withdrawal, compliance, development completion and monitoring evidence

scope_guards: An LDO proposal is not treated as an adopted order.
An adopted LDO is not treated as permission for development outside its boundary.
Order coverage is not treated as compliance with every condition.
A notification is not treated as approval where prior approval is required.
An expired or withdrawn order is not treated as current permission.
Permitted development is not treated as completed construction.
Completed construction is not treated as lawful operation without condition compliance.
No score or promotion is written without exact order, boundary, class, conditions, construction and operation evidence.
